jobs.description_text: NOTE: Although this position is in support of our US Government work, this role is located in Wiesbaden, Germany. The Role Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions. As an FDSE your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. jobs.title: Information Security Engineer - Infrastructure Security
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · New York, NY · Washington, D.C.
jobs.description_text: The Role We're looking for an Information Security Engineer who can think broadly about how infrastructure is built, attacked, defended, and improved. You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment. As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements. This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice.

jobs.title: Intellectual Property Counsel
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · Denver, CO · New York, NY · Palo Alto, CA · Washington, D.C.
jobs.description_text: The Role Palantir's in-house legal team works to proactively address legal issues so that Palantir can continue to drive positive impact in the world. Our IP Counsel are the legal backbone of Palantir's intellectual property strategy across all domains: patents, trademark, copyright, and trade secret. In this role you'll become a go-to advisor on the protection of Palantir's cutting edge technology. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide array of intellectual property matters, including patent harvesting, portfolio development, and landscaping, trademark strategy and management, licensing and partnership agreements, open source strategy and compliance, product development issues, and strategic advice for product and business teams. Our ideal candidate has strong technical and interpersonal skills, meaning you are comfortable working with a variety of stakeholders from software developers and internal business teams, to third parties. You're able to maintain focus on the details and can take on novel, complex issues as they arise, whilst also holding the ownership and sense of responsibility needed to bring large and multi-stepped projects to completion. Although focused on intellectual property, as a member of the legal team you're excited to work on the broad range of projects that arise at a fast-paced, dynamic company.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst - US Government Security
jobs.description_text: The Role As an Operations Analyst supporting our US Government teams, you keep the mission moving by tracking and stabilizing projects, removing roadblocks, owning operational outcomes, and staying two steps ahead so the team can focus on what they do best. This role demands a varying range of responsibilities; you could be managing a classified facility and vendors one hour and scoping process improvement initiatives the next. You're a first-responder by instinct, a systems thinker by habit, someone who finds order in ambiguity, sees friction as a problem worth solving and shows up everyday with a Get Things Done mentality. Communication and attention to detail are core to how you operate, not afterthoughts. You'll be part of a high-accountability, high-expectation team that is just as invested in each other's success as they are in Palantir's mission. Feedback isn't just welcomed here, it's how we get better.

jobs.description_text: The Role Palantir's Defense Applied AI product team builds products that help the modern warfighter leverage AI for their most mission-critical work. You will help own the entire end to end Agent experience in our products and work relentlessly to ensure they deliver value for our users, while maintaining a high bar for quality. Your day-to-day workflow will vary, adapting to the requirements of our users and the technical challenges that arise. One day, you may find yourself collaborating with users to refine the UX of a particular workflow, the next you could be fine-tuning performance to enable low-latency or more accurate operational outcomes. Our Product Development organization is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product and work collaboratively to build cross functional capabilities, streamline user workflows and continuously improve our software's efficiency and reliability. We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable AI products, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internship - Query Engines
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · New York, NY
jobs.description_text: The Role We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption. You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. The Director of Grassroots Operations (DOGO) is a senior leader on the state leadership team responsible for building, scaling, and optimizing AFP’s grassroots field capability and plays a critical part in developing talent, executing grassroots strategy, and driving community impact. You are a people leader and oversee the full grassroots talent lifecycle—from recruiting and onboarding to coaching, performance management, and long-term development—while ensuring your team delivers high-impact results across events, volunteer activation, and policy engagement. This role will be working in the field and be based in Texas. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000–$85,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization. Consistent with this approach, base salary may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

jobs.title: Director, Corporate Partnerships
jobs.description_text: As a Director of Corporate Partnerships, you'll identify and develop high-value partnerships with Fortune 500 companies that expand economic opportunity and innovation, remove barriers to education and meaningful work, strengthen communities, and bring people together around shared solutions. You'll work with senior business leaders to understand their priorities, identify opportunities that benefit both organizations, and build partnerships that create lasting value for companies and society. This isn't a traditional corporate partnerships role. You'll need the business acumen and entrepreneurial judgment to recognize opportunities others might miss, develop new approaches, and influence meaningful corporate decisions. You'll help companies put their people, resources, expertise, and influence behind solutions that expand opportunity and improve lives, demonstrating how business leadership can drive lasting change. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $150,000–$175,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus or variable compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization. We believe incentives matter. Consistent with this approach, compensation may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

jobs.title: Email Content Strategist
jobs.description_text: As an Email Content Strategist on the Grassroots Editorial Team, you'll help Americans for Prosperity (AFP) develop compelling email campaigns that engage grassroots audiences, advances policy priorities, and inspire people to take action. In this role, you'll write and edit high-impact grassroots emails, including advocacy campaigns, newsletters, lifecycle communications, and event promotions. You'll also collaborate with our Growth, Marketing, and Lifecycle teams to develop content calendars and identify opportunities to improve audience engagement and campaign performance. This role requires 3+ years of professional writing experience in political communications, public policy, or grassroots advocacy, along with a strong understanding of email marketing and audience engagement. You should bring excellent writing and editing skills, sound editorial judgment, an analytical mindset, and an entrepreneurial approach to turning organizational priorities into action. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $75,000–$100,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization. Consistent with this approach, base salary may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

Du hältst dem Team im Tagesgeschäft den Rücken frei, überwachst die Budgets nach klaren Vorgaben und bereitest die Performance-Daten in übersichtlichen Reportings auf. Durch deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kampagnen verlässlich laufen und optimiert werden. Aufgaben Kampagnen-Setup & Pflege: Du buchst Google-Ads-Kampagnen (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) nach klaren Vorgaben ein und pflegst Anzeigen, Texte sowie Budgets im System. Tägliches Monitoring: Du überwachst laufend die Performance und die Tagesbudgets unserer Accounts, um einen reibungslosen und fehlerfreien Ablauf der Kampagnen sicherzustellen. Datenpflege & Reporting: Du exportierst regelmäßig die Leistungsdaten der Werbekampagnen und bereitest diese in übersichtlichen Excel-Listen oder Dashboards für das Management auf. Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Du unterstützt bei der täglichen Organisation der Marketing-Aktivitäten, übernimmst die Abstimmung von Werbemitteln (wie Bildern und Texten) und erledigst anfallende Routineaufgaben im Account. Qualifikation Ausbildung oder Studium: Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännis

jobs.description_text: Du liebst das dynamische E-Commerce-Game und brennst für Plattformen wie Walmart, Bol, Otto, eBay und Kaufland? Wir suchen jemanden, der Marktplätze nicht nur versteht, sondern sie aktiv steuert, optimiert und skaliert. Als Marketplace Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die operative und strategische Führung verschiedener Marktplatz-Accounts. Du sorgst für maximale Sichtbarkeit, optimierst Listings bis ins kleinste Detail, steuerst Werbekampagnen und hebst die Performance unserer Kund*innen auf das nächste Level. Aufgaben Marktplatz-Management mit Weitblick: Du steuerst und betreust die Accounts auf Plattformen wie Amazon, Otto, eBay und Kaufland eigenverantwortlich – vom Tagesgeschäft bis zur langfristigen Roadmap. Listing- & Conversion-Optimierung: Du optimierst Produktdaten, Keywords, Titel, Bullet Points und A+/Rich Content, um Rankings und Conversion Rates stetig zu steigern. Performance & Advertising: Du setzt gezielte Werbekampagnen (z. Sponsored Ads) auf, steuerst Budgets effizient aus und optimierst kontinuierlich auf ROAS, ACoS und Umsatz. Sortiment & Buy-Box-Management: Du behältst Lagerbestände, Buy-Box-Anteile, Preisstrategien sowie Kundenfeedback im Auge und reagierst schnell auf Marktbewegungen. Zahlen & Learnings teilen: Du analysierst die Performance-Daten aller Kanäle, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Qualifikation Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Marktplatz-Management mit – insbesondere im Amazon
